description: This file implements a logging integration for Langsmith, a component of the litellm project. It defines the LangsmithLogger class for batching and sending logs and handles credentials, batching, and serialization details specific to Langsmith's API.

classes.name: LangsmithLogger
classes.description: A custom batch logger for integrating with Langsmith's API, supporting batching, credential management, and async communication.

methods.name: __init__( self, langsmith_api_key: Optional[str] = None, langsmith_project: Optional[str] = None, langsmith_base_url: Optional[str] = None, langsmith_sampling_rate: Optional[float] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the LangsmithLogger instance, setting credentials, batch size, and starting periodic flush task.

methods.name: LangsmithCredentialsObject get_credentials_from_env( self, langsmith_api_key: Optional[str] = None, langsmith_project: Optional[str] = None, langsmith_base_url: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves credentials from environment variables or provided parameters.

methods.name: _prepare_log_data( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time, credentials: LangsmithCredentialsObject, )
methods.description: Prepares the log data payload for sending to Langsmith, including handling metadata, IDs, and serialization.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a successful event synchronously, with sampling control.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronous version of log_success_event, queues the log for batch sending.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Queues a failure event asynchronously for later batch sending.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Sends queued logs in batches grouped by credentials.

methods.name: str _add_endpoint_to_url( self, url: str, endpoint: str, api_version: str = "/api/v1" )
methods.description: Constructs API endpoint URL based on base URL and endpoint path.

methods.name: _log_batch_on_langsmith( self, credentials: LangsmithCredentialsObject, queue_objects: List[LangsmithQueueObject], )
methods.description: Handles sending a batch of logs to Langsmith's /batch endpoint.

methods.name: Dict[CredentialsKey,BatchGroup] _group_batches_by_credentials(self)
methods.description: Groups queued log objects according to their credentials for batch processing.

methods.name: float _get_sampling_rate_to_use_for_request(self, kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Determines sampling rate for logging based on dynamic parameters.

methods.name: LangsmithCredentialsObject _get_credentials_to_use_for_request( self, kwargs: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Selects credentials for the current request, considering dynamic parameters.

methods.name: _send_batch(self)
methods.description: Dispatches the batch of logs by calling the asynchronous send method.

methods.name: get_run_by_id(self, run_id)
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific run from Langsmith API.

methods.name: make_dot_order(self, run_id: str)
methods.description: Creates a dotted order string for tracing, based on timestamp and run ID.
